This checks the budget is enforced; raw telegram throughput beyond it is not independently observable from outside the process. A flood submitted all at once (as this scenario does, deliberately — §23.1's own 'simultaneous fades') sends its first ~15 telegrams in one burst, then another ~15 about a second later as that whole burst ages out together; a window straddling two such bursts can read a little over 15 without the limiter actually being broken — see the module docstring before treating a marginal BREACHED as a defect.
